pay.title: Pay for this order
pay.text: Choose how you want to pay. Your items stay reserved until {time}.

pay.redirecting: Redirecting you to the secure payment page…

status.title: Payment status
status.pendingText: We are waiting for {provider} to confirm your payment. This page updates on its own — you can safely leave it.
status.succeededText: {provider} confirmed the payment. It is recorded in your history.
status.cancelledNote: You left the payment page. If you did not pay, nothing was charged.
status.creditedToWallet: This order could no longer be paid, so the amount was credited to your DOOM Wallet.

crypto.title: Pay with USDT
crypto.intro: Send USDT from your own wallet to our address, then paste the transaction ID here. We check it on the blockchain.
crypto.exactAmount: Send exactly this amount, to the 4th decimal: it identifies your payment. If you send from an exchange, add the network fee on top so that we receive the full amount.
crypto.onlyUsdt: Send only USDT, and only on {network}. Any other coin or network is lost and cannot be recovered.
crypto.expired: The time to send this payment is over. If you sent it before the deadline, paste the transaction ID below. Otherwise do not send anything: start the payment again to get a new amount.
crypto.txHint: You find it in your wallet or exchange after sending.
crypto.found: We found your transfer. Waiting for the network to confirm it ({confirmations}/{required}).
crypto.foundTron: We found your transfer. Waiting for the network to finalise it.
